240-5470-7175-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-7175-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2822-3681.easyPrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
Grafted Exoskeleton is attached to your commander.
2822-3681.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander has power 10 or greater.
An opponent cannot block your commander.
2822-3681.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using your commander, which will get at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause the opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing your commander to give each other opponent at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause each opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

2239-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2239-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
2239-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Ardent Elementalist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

132-549-4002-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
132-549-4002-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

997-6982--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2749-4695-8089.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

654-851-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3413-3967-5929.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-676-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-676-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-3099-4289-5223.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

1115-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
1115-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

757-1432-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

5670-6792-7399--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6792-7399--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

891-2843-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1978-5457-5776.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2557-3899-4068.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

57-4846-6657-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6657-7060.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1742-2035-5631.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gollum, adding {B}.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-4948-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Estrid's Invocation trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

1447-1734-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

435-2034-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

774-3875-5233.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3698-5365-5395.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
3698-5365-5395.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' third ability and Piper Wright's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Piper Wright trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1414-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
1414-5445-5660.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1651-3888-4563.notablePrerequisites: Everflowing Chalice has at least six charge counters on it.
1283-1651-3888-4563.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, adding at least {6}.
Activate Olivia's Attendants twice by paying {6}, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers twice, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Blood tokens, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.
If Everflowing Chalice has seven or more charge counters on it, this combo nets infinite mana.

177-1418-3908.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
177-1418-3908.description:
Put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting the ability.
Gorion and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Gorion's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Vantress Visions, copying Gorion's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Gorion's trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Gorion's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

950-1512-1636.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher and Stonybrook Schoolmaster do not have summoning sickness.
950-1512-1636.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
When the Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-2517-4681-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
2034-2517-4681-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, targeting Parallax Wave.
Holding priority, activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding {C}{C}.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 5, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-1712-2362.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Endless Evil triggers, creating a 1/1 copy of Jugan.
Put the token Jugan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jugan dies, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

430-1061-1255.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-1255.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Dragon Broodmother triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

962-3099-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Yurlok.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
962-3099-5200.description:
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to add {B}{R}{G}{G} and each opponent to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large amount of times.
Move to your next phase, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.
